moqui.service.job.ServiceJob.description: Expire registration holds, offer waitlist places and reconcile their payments

moqui.server.JobRegistration.title: Event registration holds
moqui.server.JobRegistration.description: Applies the payment results of event registrations (placing the ticket order, or leaving a payment that came after its hold for review), expires the holds that ended and offers freed places to the waitlist in order, and hands waiting refunds to the payment services

moqui.server.RecoveryDescriptor.title: Event registration holds and payments
moqui.server.RecoveryDescriptor.idempotencyNote: A hold expires once (its state changes once under the offer's lock), a payment is looked up by its attempt and never sent again, an order is placed once (its status says so) and a refund carries the registration's operation key, so a run again changes only what is still due.

moqui.service.job.ServiceJob.description: Queue event registration notices that are due

moqui.server.JobRegistration.title: Event notices
moqui.server.JobRegistration.description: Queues each event offer's scheduled notices that are due (before the start, after the end, when the occurrence moves) on the delivery ledger, once per registration and notice; promotional ones only with the recipient's consent

moqui.server.RecoveryDescriptor.title: Event notices
moqui.server.RecoveryDescriptor.idempotencyNote: Each notice is one ledger delivery per registration, schedule and trigger (its event key), which the ledger answers again for a repeat, so a run again queues nothing twice.
